features.title: 湖中宣告真假率
features.oneLineHook: 藍方角色幾乎不說謊 (<1.5%), 紅方刺客最會 (54%)
features.oneLineHookEn: Blue roles rarely lie (<1.5%); red Assassin lies most (54%).
features.takeaway: AI HeuristicAgent 觀湖宣告 → 用 perRoleLieRate 表估真假機率
features.takeawayEn: AI heuristic agent reads lake declarations using these per-role lie priors.

features.title: 持湖宣告後言行一致度
features.oneLineHook: 刺客 100% 言行一致 (掩護精準), 娜 81% 最易露馬腳
features.oneLineHookEn: Assassin is 100% consistent (best cover); Morgana slips most (81%).

features.takeaway: 言行不一 = 紅方掩護 signal; 高 EV cell 給 AI 條件機率推論
features.takeawayEn: Inconsistent words/actions are red-cover signal; high-EV cells feed conditional priors.

features.title: 刺客目標座位偏好
features.oneLineHook: 隊長次數最多的玩家被刺中率 49%, 沉默玩家只有 39%
features.oneLineHookEn: Top-leader targets get hit 49%; quiet seats only 39%.
features.takeaway: 刺客模仿模式: 鎖隊長多 + 中央座位 (3-6); AI 可學該偏好調目標權重
features.takeawayEn: Pattern: lock onto vocal leaders in central seats (3-6); AI can mimic this prior.

features.title: 改隊後投票翻轉率
features.titleEn: Vote Flip Rate After Team Change
features.oneLineHook: 梅林 +1.57pp 翻得最多 (藍信號), 莫甘娜 -2.18pp 最不翻 (掩護自己)
features.oneLineHookEn: Merlin flips most (+1.57pp blue signal); Morgana flips least (-2.18pp covering self).
features.takeaway: 高翻轉率 = 藍方 (彈性反應), 低翻轉率 = 紅方 (一致掩護)
features.takeawayEn: High flip = flexible blue; low flip = red coordinated cover.

features.title: R3+ 強制 P5 局勢偏移
features.oneLineHook: R3 出現 forced P5 → 三紅率 +4.50pp, R4 +5.28pp
features.oneLineHookEn: R3 forced P5 boosts 3-red by +4.50pp; R4 by +5.28pp.

data.note: R1 forced P5 比例異常高 (Sheets 匯入 padding), 該 row 不繪入圖表。
data.noteEn: R1 forced P5 frequency is degenerate (Sheets import padding); not plotted.

features.takeaway: R3 是 matchpoint, forced P5 = 隊伍 5 連 reject → 紅方掩護成功的強信號
features.takeawayEn: R3 is matchpoint; forced P5 (5 consecutive rejections) is a strong red-cover signal.
